description: Aggregated anonymous scan statistics for ONE code: total scans, a per-day series and the device split (mobile/tablet/desktop). Bots are excluded; QRTap stores no visitor IPs or user-agents, so no per-person data exists to return. Bound the window with `from`/`to` when the user asks about a period. For a whole batch use qrtap_group_stats; for plain totals across many codes use qrtap_list_codes with include_stats.

codeId.description: The code id (UUID), as returned by qrtap_create_code, qrtap_create_codes_bulk or qrtap_list_codes. This is the internal id, not the short_url slug.

name: qrtap_code_stats
